BiblicalUsage: Chippazown is hasty flight, the hurried leaving of a place, and it belongs to the Passover and the exodus. Israel eats the lamb in haste with loins girded and staff in hand, the bread of affliction is eaten because they came out of Egypt in haste, and Isaiah promises the return will not be in haste because the Lord will go before them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the haste of the exodus and the calm of the return belong together, because the same Lord hurries His people out and leads them home in peace. I hold that God is never rushed, even when His people must be.
RelatedEvents: The Passover; The Exodus and the Red Sea
